description: Per-asset $ cost tracking with rolling window budget enforcement. Cost estimated via `cost_per_second` (wall-clock rate) or `cost_fn` (`mod:fn` callable given (context, elapsed_s, result) → USD). Cumulative cost history read from ASSET_OBSERVATION event log (`budget_cost_estimate_usd` metadata within `window_days`). Enforcement modes: warn (observation), fail (dg.Failure pre-flight or post-flight), skip (return MaterializeResult(budget_skipped=true) pre-flight). Companion @budget decorator.

outputs.description: One @dg.asset. Emits AssetObservation(budget_cost_asset=<key>) with cost_estimate/elapsed/cumulative metadata per run.

cost_per_second.label: Cost Per Second (USD)
cost_per_second.description: Wall-clock USD/sec rate; used when cost_fn is null.

cost_fn.label: Cost Function
cost_fn.description: Optional 'mod:fn' returning USD given (context, elapsed_s, result).

window_days.label: Window Days
window_days.description: Rolling window size (days) for cumulative cost sum.

on_breach.label: On Breach
on_breach.description: 'warn' always runs + observes; 'fail' raises dg.Failure; 'skip' returns MaterializeResult(budget_skipped=true).

name: Budget Asset
